mentions.note: 3rd in the National 10kms; in Windsor Great Park training photo
won Southern 10 kms women 1988; 3rd National 10 km women 1988; 3rd in National Womens 10 Kms 1988, first senior individual medal for a lady in Belgrave
3rd National / R.W.A. Womens 10K road walk; club records at 2K, 3K, 5K and 10K walking; won the 1988 Centenary Cup
6th Chippenham to Calne; won ladies Pewsey Cup; won ladies 5km London Championships 1989; 2nd National women's 15km
returned to Canada to finish her medical course; won Southern Women's 10K 1990
club record holder: senior women walking 2000m, senior women walking 3000m, senior women walking 5000m, senior women walking 10000m
